_comment: Minimum tests that must be COUNTED per project — the .trx `total`, which includes dynamically skipped tests and so does not vary by operating system; `executed` does. The control for defect class DC-012: a crashed test host reports success with a smaller count, and nothing else notices. Every NotExecuted result must also be named in `expectedSkips`, or a skip inside `total` is a hole in the floor. Raise these with `python tools/verify-test-run.py --update` when you add tests; lowering one needs --allow-lower "<reason>" and is refused otherwise. Keys with a suffix are HALVES of a project run on one OS; `splits` says which halves must account for which whole.
_expectedSkips_comment: Tests a .trx may record as NotExecuted — inside `total`, outside `executed`. Read from real result files, never written from memory. The four AgentPlane entries are CI's Windows nonportable job (181 total, 177 executed); the symlink entry is any Windows run of the portable half, where creating a symlink needs a privilege the runner lacks. An unlisted NotExecuted result is a finding, because a skip the floor cannot see is a hole in the floor exactly that wide. The real-lane entry (WL-1a, T5 node 2) runs only with AIDE_REAL_ADAPTER_ROOT set; its one recorded real run is docs/proof/workbench-loops-wl-1a/host/real-lane-stop/, and every join recount without the variable records it NotExecuted (T5 n2 join recount, 2026-10-19).
